info.name: Bubble Data API — Ambient (live schema)
info.description: Read-only exploration of the app the business runs on. `base` is the version-test branch, which despite the name is the only version in use — treat every write here as a write to production. Set the `token` collection variable first.

request.description: definitions.{type}.properties is the real list of API field names; definitions.{type}Body is what is writable. Note that option-set fields are reported as type 'option set' with NO value list — those have to be read off live rows instead.
Where the live values for the `toDo`, `weAre` and `color` option sets came from. `job` is the job NAME as text, not a link.

item.name: 3. Tool lines for a set of requests

request.description: One row per request, not per tool. `toolsSummary` holds the whole list as quoted `Name: qty` entries. `in` takes an array, which is how the app fetches lines for a page of requests in one call.
112 rows over two pages. `realtedTo` — Bubble's misspelling, keep it — lists the `toDo` job types each tool is offered for.
1,445 rows, so fifteen pages. `name` is what `request.job` stores; `description` feeds `request.searchable`.
12 PMs. `Name` and `Company` are option sets returned as display text. `Active` is set on one row only — do not filter on it. Swap the path for `timelabels` for the 14 calendar slots.

item.name: 7. User — note what is NOT here

request.description: No `email`, no `Role`, no `passwordHash`. The address is inside an opaque `authentication` object that constraints cannot reach — which is why the app does not map sessions onto Bubble users. `tempTools` is the old UI's draft tool selection.
